name: n2enginewebfrontend
description: A web frontend for editing N2Engine projects
author: Nicholas Cerisano

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/bundle.js
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test-dom.json
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/bundle-tests.js && node --test "dist/test/**/*.test.js" "dist/test-dom/**/*.test.js"
